from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Captures the relevant sorting information for a single judgment document."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书 1》)")
    matched_causes: list[str] = Field(description="A list of cause of action categories from the provided task list that this document matches")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class aggregating all extracted document information."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
